turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Namaste, Nimbus Broadband support. Kya main account holder se baat kar raha hoon?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Haan, main Sunita Verma bol rahi hoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you Sunita ji. Verification ke liye registered mobile ke last four digits bataiye.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Verified. Maine check kiya, aapke area mein koi reported outage nahi hai. Batayiye kya problem hai?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Kal raat se internet bilkul nahi chal raha. Ek dum band hai.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Samajh gaya. Router pe kaunsi lights jal rahi hain?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Power green hai, aur ek light red hai. Uske neeche LOS likha hai.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Red LOS light ka matlab hai fibre line mein signal nahi aa raha. Isko restart se theek nahi kiya ja sakta, technician ko aana padega. Main abhi ticket raise kar raha hoon.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Aapka ticket number hai NB-58213. Technician 48 ghante ke andar aayega.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 48 ghante? Mere bete ka parso online exam hai.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Main samajhta hoon. Main ticket pe priority note daal deta hoon, lekin exact time ka promise nahi kar sakta. Technician aane se pehle aapko SMS aayega.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Aur jitne din internet band hai, uska paisa?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Agar outage 24 ghante se zyada ka confirm hota hai, to technician visit ke baad aapke account mein service credit add ho sakta hai. Maximum teen din ke charges tak.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. Ticket number ek baar phir bataiye.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: NB-58213. Ye SMS pe bhi aa jayega. To summary ye hai: line fault hai, technician 48 ghante mein aayega, aur service credit visit ke baad confirm hoga.
